title: Meet our Training Consultant: Renaud Bournonville
excerpt:
In this interview, Renaud Bournonville introduces us to his job as a Training Consultant at Q-Leap.
As an ISTQB certification training consultant, Renaud explains with passion the challenges and joys he discovers on a daily basis.
description: Renaud Bournonville is one of our training consultants. In this interview, he tells us what he loves about his job and explains, with humor and wisdom, the challenges he overcomes every day.
